description: This PHP source file defines the Dashboard controller class for the OpenCart admin extension. It handles listing available dashboard extensions, installing and uninstalling dashboards, permission validation, and rendering the dashboard management view.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: Controller class managing the dashboard extension modules within the OpenCart admin panel, enabling listing, installation, uninstallation, and permission checks for dashboard widgets.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Entries the main view, displaying the list of dashboard extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Loads available dashboard extension files, checks installed extensions, and prepares data for the dashboard management view.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to modify dashboard extensions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process of a dashboard extension, including permission setup and registering necessary components.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process, including removing permissions and calling extension-specific uninstallation routines.
